This document reproduces the primary episode-based incidence, prevalence, and duration estimates, including household-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals, followed by the Poisson sensitivity analysis of recurrent episodes.

## Episode burden

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TiNTS manuscript eNTS burden analysis:
# incidence, duration, prevalence, and person-time at risk
# ============================================================
#
# Implements the manuscript episode-based methods:
#   1. eNTS episodes are already defined in episodes_df:
#        - episode starts after >=2 negatives followed by >=1 positive
#        - episode ends after >=2 negatives following positivity
#
#   2. Time at risk:
#        - participants are at risk from first to last PCR observation
#        - subtract all time when they cannot be considered at risk:
#            a) left-censored PCR-positive periods
#            b) completed eNTS episode periods
#            c) right-censored terminal PCR-positive periods
#        - for completed episodes, re-entry to risk occurs at end_upper
#          i.e. when the episode can be said to have ended by definition
#
#   3. Duration and prevalence:
#        - calculated only for episodes with observed onset and observed offset
#        - onset = 24 h before first PCR-positive sample in episode
#        - offset = 24 h after final PCR-positive sample in episode
#
#   4. Incidence:
#        - primary estimate uses only episodes with observed onset AND offset
#          because right-censored terminal episodes are excluded from incidence/prevalence
#
#   5. Confidence intervals:
#        - household-clustered bootstrap
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(here)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1)
n_boot <- 2000
padding_days <- 1

# Primary analysis setting:
# FALSE = incidence uses only episodes with observed onset AND observed offset.
# TRUE  = sensitivity: incidence uses all observed-onset episodes, including right-censored terminal events.
include_right_censored_in_incidence <- FALSE

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

to_date_safe <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))

  x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x_chr[x_chr %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", ".")] <- NA_character_

  out <- as.Date(rep(NA_character_, length(x_chr)))

  # TiNTS/Stata-style dates, e.g. 01jan2024 or 01JAN2024
  idx <- !is.na(x_chr) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}[A-Za-z]{3}\\d{4}$", x_chr)
  if (any(idx)) {
    out[idx] <- as.Date(
      tolower(x_chr[idx]),
      format = "%d%b%Y"
    )
  }

  # ISO dates, e.g. 2024-01-01
  idx <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x_chr) &
    grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}$", x_chr)
  if (any(idx)) {
    out[idx] <- as.Date(
      x_chr[idx],
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  }

  # UK numeric dates, e.g. 01/01/2024 or 01-01-2024
  idx <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x_chr) &
    grepl("^\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{4}$", x_chr)
  if (any(idx) && requireNamespace("lubridate", quietly = TRUE)) {
    out[idx] <- as.Date(
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::dmy(x_chr[idx], quiet = TRUE))
    )
  }

  # Final fallback for any remaining common date representations
  idx <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x_chr)
  if (any(idx) && requireNamespace("lubridate", quietly = TRUE)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::parse_date_time(
        x_chr[idx],
        orders = c(
          "dmy", "ymd",
          "d b Y", "d B Y",
          "Y-m-d", "d/m/Y", "d-m-Y"
        ),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
    out[idx] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }

  out
}

safe_divide <- function(num, den) {
  ifelse(is.finite(den) & den > 0, num / den, NA_real_)
}

interval_union_days <- function(start, stop) {
  x <- tibble(
    start = as.numeric(start),
    stop  = as.numeric(stop)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(start),
      is.finite(stop),
      stop > start
    ) %>%
    arrange(start, stop)

  if (nrow(x) == 0) return(0)

  current_start <- x$start[1]
  current_stop  <- x$stop[1]
  total <- 0

  if (nrow(x) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:nrow(x)) {
      if (x$start[i] <= current_stop) {
        current_stop <- max(current_stop, x$stop[i])
      } else {
        total <- total + (current_stop - current_start)
        current_start <- x$start[i]
        current_stop  <- x$stop[i]
      }
    }
  }

  total + (current_stop - current_start)
}

format_est <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "—",
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
  )
}

q_safe <- function(x, prob) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(quantile(x, prob, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load required objects if not already in environment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("episodes_df")) {
  episodes_df <- readr::read_rds(here::here("rds", "episodes_df.rds"))
}

if (!exists("followup_df")) {
  followup_df <- readr::read_rds(here::here("rds", "followup_df.rds"))
}

# Need PCR-level data to identify the final positive sample in each episode.
if (exists("pcr_long")) {
  pcr_data <- pcr_long
} else if (exists("CRF_PCR")) {
  pcr_data <- CRF_PCR
} else {
  pcr_data <- readr::read_csv(
    here::here("data_clean", "bayesian_pcr_for_epi_analysis_28052025.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prepare follow-up denominator
# ------------------------------------------------------------

followup_chapter <- followup_df %>%
  mutate(
    first_obs = to_date_safe(first_obs),
    last_obs  = to_date_safe(last_obs),
    first_obs_num = as.numeric(first_obs),
    last_obs_num  = as.numeric(last_obs),
    followup_days = as.numeric(last_obs - first_obs)
  ) %>%
  select(pid, hhid, first_obs, last_obs, first_obs_num, last_obs_num, followup_days) %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pid),
    !is.na(hhid),
    !is.na(first_obs),
    !is.na(last_obs),
    is.finite(followup_days),
    followup_days > 0
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare PCR data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pcr_data <- pcr_data %>%
  mutate(
    data_date = to_date_safe(data_date)
  )

if ("pcr_pos" %in% names(pcr_data)) {
  pcr_data <- pcr_data %>%
    mutate(pcr_pos = as.integer(pcr_pos))
} else {
  if (!"CT_Value" %in% names(pcr_data)) {
    stop("PCR data must contain either pcr_pos or CT_Value.")
  }

  pcr_data <- pcr_data %>%
    mutate(
      pcr_pos = case_when(
        is.na(CT_Value) ~ NA_integer_,
        as.character(CT_Value) == "PCR negative" ~ 0L,
        TRUE ~ 1L
      )
    )
}

pcr_data <- pcr_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pid),
    !is.na(data_date),
    !is.na(pcr_pos)
  ) %>%
  select(pid, data_date, pcr_pos)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare episode table and derive final positive date
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_episode_cols <- c("pid", "hhid", "onset_lower", "onset_upper", "end_upper")
missing_episode_cols <- setdiff(required_episode_cols, names(episodes_df))

if (length(missing_episode_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "episodes_df is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_episode_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

episodes_base <- episodes_df %>%
  mutate(
    onset_lower = to_date_safe(onset_lower),
    onset_upper = to_date_safe(onset_upper),
    end_upper   = to_date_safe(end_upper)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    followup_chapter %>%
      select(pid, first_obs, last_obs, first_obs_num, last_obs_num),
    by = "pid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    episode_row_id = row_number(),
    observed_onset = !is.na(onset_lower) & !is.na(onset_upper),
    observed_offset = !is.na(end_upper),
    closed_episode = observed_onset & observed_offset
  )

# Derive final PCR-positive sample date within each episode.
# If end_upper is present, final positive must occur before end_upper.
# If end_upper is absent, final positive is derived up to last follow-up.
derived_last_positive <- episodes_base %>%
  select(episode_row_id, pid, onset_upper, end_upper, last_obs) %>%
  left_join(pcr_data, by = "pid") %>%
  filter(
    pcr_pos == 1L,
    !is.na(onset_upper),
    data_date >= onset_upper,
    case_when(
      !is.na(end_upper) ~ data_date < end_upper,
      is.na(end_upper) & !is.na(last_obs) ~ data_date <= last_obs,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(episode_row_id) %>%
  summarise(
    last_positive = max(data_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

episodes_base <- episodes_base %>%
  left_join(derived_last_positive, by = "episode_row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # Fallback: if no PCR row is matched, use onset_upper.
    last_positive = coalesce(last_positive, onset_upper)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Construct all non-at-risk episode windows
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#
# For time-at-risk:
#   - if onset observed: not-at-risk starts 24 h before first positive
#   - if onset not observed: not-at-risk starts at first observation
#   - if offset observed: participant re-enters risk set at end_upper
#   - if offset not observed: not-at-risk continues to last observation
#
# This removes:
#   - completed episodes
#   - left-censored positive periods
#   - right-censored terminal positive periods

not_at_risk_windows <- episodes_base %>%
  mutate(
    nonrisk_start_num = case_when(
      observed_onset ~ pmax(as.numeric(onset_upper) - padding_days, first_obs_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      !observed_onset ~ first_obs_num,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    nonrisk_stop_num = case_when(
      observed_offset ~ pmin(as.numeric(end_upper), last_obs_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      !observed_offset ~ last_obs_num,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pid),
    !is.na(hhid),
    is.finite(nonrisk_start_num),
    is.finite(nonrisk_stop_num),
    nonrisk_stop_num > nonrisk_start_num
  ) %>%
  select(
    pid, hhid, episode_row_id, observed_onset, observed_offset, closed_episode,
    nonrisk_start_num, nonrisk_stop_num
  )

not_at_risk_by_pid <- not_at_risk_windows %>%
  group_by(pid, hhid) %>%
  summarise(
    not_at_risk_days = interval_union_days(nonrisk_start_num, nonrisk_stop_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Construct completed-episode duration windows
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Duration/prevalence are based only on episodes with observed onset and offset.
# Duration window:
#   onset  = first positive - 1 day
#   offset = final positive + 1 day
#
# This is deliberately not the same as end_upper, because end_upper is the
# clearance-confirmation boundary used for re-entry into the risk set.

episode_duration_chapter <- episodes_base %>%
  filter(closed_episode) %>%
  mutate(
    duration_start_num = pmax(
      as.numeric(onset_upper) - padding_days,
      first_obs_num,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    duration_stop_num = pmin(
      as.numeric(last_positive) + padding_days,
      last_obs_num,
      as.numeric(end_upper),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    duration_days = duration_stop_num - duration_start_num,
    duration_start = as.Date(duration_start_num, origin = "1970-01-01"),
    duration_stop  = as.Date(duration_stop_num,  origin = "1970-01-01")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(duration_start_num),
    is.finite(duration_stop_num),
    duration_stop_num > duration_start_num
  ) %>%
  select(
    pid, hhid, episode_row_id,
    episode_id, episode_order, singleton, n_pos,
    onset_lower, onset_upper, last_positive, end_upper,
    duration_start, duration_stop,
    duration_start_num, duration_stop_num,
    duration_days
  )

closed_episode_days_by_pid <- episode_duration_chapter %>%
  group_by(pid, hhid) %>%
  summarise(
    closed_episode_days = interval_union_days(duration_start_num, duration_stop_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

closed_episodes_by_pid <- episode_duration_chapter %>%
  count(pid, hhid, name = "n_closed_episodes")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Select incidence numerator
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (include_right_censored_in_incidence) {
  episode_incidence_chapter <- episodes_base %>%
    filter(observed_onset) %>%
    select(pid, hhid, episode_row_id, episode_id, episode_order, observed_offset)
} else {
  episode_incidence_chapter <- episode_duration_chapter %>%
    select(pid, hhid, episode_row_id, episode_id, episode_order) %>%
    mutate(observed_offset = TRUE)
}

incidence_episodes_by_pid <- episode_incidence_chapter %>%
  count(pid, hhid, name = "n_incidence_episodes")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Person-level burden dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Incidence denominator:
#   total at-risk time = follow-up - all non-at-risk episode windows.
#
# Prevalence denominator:
#   time that is classifiable as either:
#      a) at risk, or
#      b) inside a completed eNTS episode duration window.
#
# This avoids including left-censored or right-censored positive time
# in the prevalence denominator.

person_time_chapter <- followup_chapter %>%
  left_join(not_at_risk_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
  left_join(closed_episode_days_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
  left_join(closed_episodes_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
  left_join(incidence_episodes_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
  mutate(
    not_at_risk_days = replace_na(not_at_risk_days, 0),
    closed_episode_days = replace_na(closed_episode_days, 0),
    n_closed_episodes = replace_na(n_closed_episodes, 0L),
    n_incidence_episodes = replace_na(n_incidence_episodes, 0L),

    at_risk_days = pmax(followup_days - not_at_risk_days, 0),

    # Denominator for person-time prevalence of completed/evaluable episodes.
    prevalence_denominator_days = at_risk_days + closed_episode_days
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Audit counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

chapter_episode_audit <- episodes_base %>%
  summarise(
    total_episode_rows = n(),
    observed_onset_episodes = sum(observed_onset, na.rm = TRUE),
    closed_onset_and_offset_episodes = sum(closed_episode, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_onset_right_censored_episodes = sum(observed_onset & !observed_offset, na.rm = TRUE),
    left_censored_or_unbounded_onset_rows = sum(!observed_onset, na.rm = TRUE),
    participants_with_any_episode_row = n_distinct(pid),
    participants_with_observed_onset_episode = n_distinct(pid[observed_onset]),
    participants_with_closed_episode = n_distinct(pid[closed_episode])
  )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("EPISODE SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(chapter_episode_audit, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Summary function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summarise_chapter_burden <- function(person_df, duration_episode_df, incidence_episode_df) {

  duration_values <- duration_episode_df$duration_days

  total_incidence_events <- nrow(incidence_episode_df)
  total_duration_episodes <- nrow(duration_episode_df)

  total_followup_days <- sum(person_df$followup_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_not_at_risk_days <- sum(person_df$not_at_risk_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_at_risk_days <- sum(person_df$at_risk_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_closed_episode_days <- sum(person_df$closed_episode_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_prevalence_denominator_days <- sum(person_df$prevalence_denominator_days, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    n_participants = n_distinct(person_df$pid),
    n_households = n_distinct(person_df$hhid),

    n_incidence_events = total_incidence_events,
    n_duration_prevalence_episodes = total_duration_episodes,

    n_participants_with_incidence_events = n_distinct(incidence_episode_df$pid),
    n_participants_with_duration_prevalence_episodes = n_distinct(duration_episode_df$pid),

    total_followup_days = total_followup_days,
    total_not_at_risk_days = total_not_at_risk_days,
    total_at_risk_days = total_at_risk_days,
    total_closed_episode_days = total_closed_episode_days,
    total_prevalence_denominator_days = total_prevalence_denominator_days,

    mean_duration_days = mean(duration_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration_days = median(duration_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_duration_days = q_safe(duration_values, 0.25),
    q3_duration_days = q_safe(duration_values, 0.75),
    min_duration_days = min(duration_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_duration_days = max(duration_values, na.rm = TRUE),

    incidence_per_1000_person_days =
      safe_divide(total_incidence_events, total_at_risk_days) * 1000,

    incidence_per_100_person_years =
      safe_divide(total_incidence_events, total_at_risk_days / 365.25) * 100,

    incidence_per_100_participants_28_days =
      safe_divide(total_incidence_events, total_at_risk_days) * 28 * 100,

    person_time_prevalence_percent =
      safe_divide(total_closed_episode_days, total_prevalence_denominator_days) * 100
  )
}

burden_estimates_chapter <- summarise_chapter_burden(
  person_df = person_time_chapter,
  duration_episode_df = episode_duration_chapter,
  incidence_episode_df = episode_incidence_chapter
)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("MAIN BURDEN ESTIMATES\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(burden_estimates_chapter, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Household-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_ids <- unique(person_time_chapter$hhid)

bootstrap_once_chapter <- function(i) {

  sampled_clusters <- sample(
    cluster_ids,
    length(cluster_ids),
    replace = TRUE
  )

  person_boot <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_clusters), function(j) {
    person_time_chapter %>%
      filter(hhid == sampled_clusters[j]) %>%
      mutate(bootstrap_cluster_id = j)
  })

  duration_episode_boot <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_clusters), function(j) {
    episode_duration_chapter %>%
      filter(hhid == sampled_clusters[j]) %>%
      mutate(bootstrap_cluster_id = j)
  })

  incidence_episode_boot <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_clusters), function(j) {
    episode_incidence_chapter %>%
      filter(hhid == sampled_clusters[j]) %>%
      mutate(bootstrap_cluster_id = j)
  })

  summarise_chapter_burden(
    person_df = person_boot,
    duration_episode_df = duration_episode_boot,
    incidence_episode_df = incidence_episode_boot
  ) %>%
    mutate(bootstrap_iteration = i)
}

boot_estimates_chapter <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(n_boot),
  bootstrap_once_chapter
)

metric_vars <- c(
  "total_not_at_risk_days",
  "total_at_risk_days",
  "total_closed_episode_days",
  "total_prevalence_denominator_days",
  "mean_duration_days",
  "median_duration_days",
  "incidence_per_1000_person_days",
  "incidence_per_100_person_years",
  "incidence_per_100_participants_28_days",
  "person_time_prevalence_percent"
)

bootstrap_ci_chapter <- boot_estimates_chapter %>%
  select(all_of(metric_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "boot_value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    ci_low = quantile(boot_value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_high = quantile(boot_value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Manuscript-ready table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metric_labels <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "total_not_at_risk_days",
    "total_at_risk_days",
    "total_closed_episode_days",
    "total_prevalence_denominator_days",
    "mean_duration_days",
    "median_duration_days",
    "incidence_per_1000_person_days",
    "incidence_per_100_person_years",
    "incidence_per_100_participants_28_days",
    "person_time_prevalence_percent"
  ),
  Measure = c(
    "Total non-at-risk episode time",
    "Total time at risk",
    "Total completed eNTS episode time",
    "Total evaluable person-time for prevalence",
    "Mean eNTS episode duration",
    "Median eNTS episode duration",
    "eNTS episode incidence",
    "eNTS episode incidence",
    "eNTS episode incidence",
    "Person-time prevalence of eNTS episodes"
  ),
  Unit = c(
    "person-days",
    "person-days",
    "episode-days",
    "person-days",
    "days",
    "days",
    "episodes per 1000 person-days at risk",
    "episodes per 100 person-years at risk",
    "episodes per 100 participants over 28 days at risk",
    "%"
  ),
  digits = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2)
)

burden_table_metrics <- burden_estimates_chapter %>%
  select(all_of(metric_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) %>%
  left_join(bootstrap_ci_chapter, by = "metric") %>%
  left_join(metric_labels, by = "metric") %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = case_when(
      digits == 1 ~ format_est(estimate, 1),
      digits == 2 ~ format_est(estimate, 2),
      TRUE ~ format_est(estimate, 2)
    ),
    `95% CI` = case_when(
      digits == 1 ~ paste0(format_est(ci_low, 1), "–", format_est(ci_high, 1)),
      digits == 2 ~ paste0(format_est(ci_low, 2), "–", format_est(ci_high, 2)),
      TRUE ~ paste0(format_est(ci_low, 2), "–", format_est(ci_high, 2))
    ),
    `Analysis denominator` = case_when(
      metric %in% c("mean_duration_days", "median_duration_days") ~
        paste0(
          burden_estimates_chapter$n_duration_prevalence_episodes,
          " completed episodes"
        ),

      metric %in% c(
        "incidence_per_1000_person_days",
        "incidence_per_100_person_years",
        "incidence_per_100_participants_28_days"
      ) ~
        paste0(
          burden_estimates_chapter$n_incidence_events,
          " episodes / ",
          format_est(burden_estimates_chapter$total_at_risk_days, 1),
          " person-days at risk"
        ),

      metric == "person_time_prevalence_percent" ~
        paste0(
          format_est(burden_estimates_chapter$total_closed_episode_days, 1),
          " completed episode-days / ",
          format_est(burden_estimates_chapter$total_prevalence_denominator_days, 1),
          " evaluable person-days"
        ),

      metric == "total_at_risk_days" ~
        "Total follow-up minus all non-at-risk episode windows",

      metric == "total_not_at_risk_days" ~
        "Completed, left-censored, and right-censored episode windows",

      metric == "total_closed_episode_days" ~
        paste0(
          burden_estimates_chapter$n_duration_prevalence_episodes,
          " completed episodes"
        ),

      metric == "total_prevalence_denominator_days" ~
        "At-risk time plus completed episode time",

      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Measure,
    Unit,
    Estimate,
    `95% CI`,
    `Analysis denominator`
  )

burden_table_counts <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Participants included",
    "Households included",
    "Total follow-up",
    "Episode rows identified",
    "Observed-onset episodes",
    "Completed episodes with observed onset and offset",
    "Right-censored observed-onset episodes",
    "Left-censored/unbounded-onset episode rows",
    "Participants with completed episodes",
    "Incidence numerator setting"
  ),
  Unit = c(
    "n", "n", "person-days", "episodes", "episodes", "episodes",
    "episodes", "episodes", "n", ""
  ),
  Estimate = c(
    burden_estimates_chapter$n_participants,
    burden_estimates_chapter$n_households,
    format_est(burden_estimates_chapter$total_followup_days, 1),
    chapter_episode_audit$total_episode_rows,
    chapter_episode_audit$observed_onset_episodes,
    chapter_episode_audit$closed_onset_and_offset_episodes,
    chapter_episode_audit$observed_onset_right_censored_episodes,
    chapter_episode_audit$left_censored_or_unbounded_onset_rows,
    burden_estimates_chapter$n_participants_with_duration_prevalence_episodes,
    ifelse(
      include_right_censored_in_incidence,
      "Observed-onset episodes, including right-censored events",
      "Completed episodes only; right-censored events excluded"
    )
  ),
  `95% CI` = "",
  `Analysis denominator` = ""
)

chapter_burden_table_full <- bind_rows(
  burden_table_counts,
  burden_table_metrics
)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("MANUSCRIPT-READY BURDEN TABLE\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(chapter_burden_table_full, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Extra printed diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("EVENTS PER PARTICIPANT: COMPLETED EPISODES\n")
cat("==============================\n")

episode_duration_chapter %>%
  count(pid, name = "n_completed_events") %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants_with_completed_events = n(),
    min_events_per_person = min(n_completed_events),
    max_events_per_person = max(n_completed_events),
    median_events_per_person = median(n_completed_events),
    mean_events_per_person = mean(n_completed_events)
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

episode_duration_chapter %>%
  count(pid, name = "n_completed_events") %>%
  count(n_completed_events, name = "n_participants") %>%
  arrange(n_completed_events) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DURATION DISTRIBUTION: COMPLETED EPISODES\n")
cat("==============================\n")

episode_duration_chapter %>%
  summarise(
    n_episodes = n(),
    mean_duration = mean(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration = median(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = q_safe(duration_days, 0.25),
    q3 = q_safe(duration_days, 0.75),
    min = min(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(here::here("outputs", "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  chapter_burden_table_full,
  here::here(
    "outputs",
    "tables",
    "chapter5_ents_incidence_duration_prevalence_time_at_risk.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  chapter_episode_audit,
  here::here(
    "outputs",
    "tables",
    "chapter5_ents_episode_audit_counts.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  person_time_chapter,
  here::here(
    "outputs",

    "chapter5_ents_person_time_denominators.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(

  )
)

write_csv(

  here::here(
    "outputs",

    "chapter5_ents_burden_bootstrap_estimates.csv"
  )
)
```

## Poisson recurrence sensitivity

```{r}
# ======================================================================
# POISSON SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS OF RECURRENT eNTS EPISODES
#
# Sensitivity question:
# Are repeat incident episodes more concentrated within individuals than
# expected if distinct acquisitions occur as a Poisson process?
#
# IMPORTANT:
# This uses EXACTLY the primary-analysis objects created above:
#   - n_incidence_episodes = completed episodes used in incidence numerator
#   - at_risk_days         = evaluable susceptible person-time
#
# It does NOT reconstruct episodes from PCR data.
#
# Interpretation:
#   No excess of participants with >=2 episodes supports the interpretation
#   that recurrent detections are compatible with distinct acquisitions.
#
#   Excess recurrence would be compatible with recrudescence/intermittent
#   shedding, but would not prove it because heterogeneous exposure and
#   household transmission can also produce clustering.
# ======================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

set.seed(20260826)
B <- 20000L

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Use the exact participant-level numerator and denominator from the
#    primary burden analysis
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

poisson_df <- person_time_chapter %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    hhid,
    at_risk_days = as.numeric(at_risk_days),
    n_events = as.integer(n_incidence_episodes)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_events = replace_na(n_events, 0L)
  )

# A participant with no susceptible risk-time cannot contribute an incident
# event. Stop if the frozen objects violate that logical requirement.
bad_zero_risk <- poisson_df %>%
  filter(at_risk_days <= 0, n_events > 0)

if (nrow(bad_zero_risk) > 0) {
  print(bad_zero_risk)
  stop("At least one participant has an incident event but zero at-risk time.")
}

# Zero-risk participants with zero events contribute nothing to a Poisson
# rate model with an offset, so exclude them from model fitting only.
poisson_model_df <- poisson_df %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(at_risk_days),
    at_risk_days > 0
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Intercept-only Poisson regression with susceptible person-time offset
#
# H0: incident episodes occur independently at a common rate per at-risk day.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

poisson_fit <- glm(
  n_events ~ 1 + offset(log(at_risk_days)),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = poisson_model_df
)

poisson_model_df <- poisson_model_df %>%
  mutate(
    expected_events = fitted(poisson_fit)
  )

rate_per_day <- exp(coef(poisson_fit)[1])
rate_per_1000_pd <- 1000 * rate_per_day

rate_se <- sqrt(vcov(poisson_fit)[1, 1])

rate_ci_per_1000_pd <- 1000 * exp(
  coef(poisson_fit)[1] + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * rate_se
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Primary incidence summary
#    Compare equivalent calculations, but do not halt the public workflow
#    for small numerical/reconstruction differences.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

frozen_events <- nrow(episode_incidence_chapter)
frozen_risk_days <- sum(person_time_chapter$at_risk_days, na.rm = TRUE)
frozen_incidence <- frozen_events / frozen_risk_days * 1000

audit_incidence <- tibble::tibble(
  quantity = c(
    "Incident episodes",
    "At-risk person-days",
    "Direct incidence per 1000 person-days",
    "Poisson intercept-derived incidence per 1000 person-days",
    "Burden-table incidence per 1000 person-days"
  ),
  value = c(
    sum(poisson_model_df$n_events),
    sum(poisson_model_df$at_risk_days),
    frozen_incidence,
    rate_per_1000_pd,
    burden_estimates_chapter$incidence_per_1000_person_days
  )
)

write_csv(
  audit_incidence,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "primary_incidence_summary.csv")
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("PRIMARY INCIDENCE SUMMARY\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Events:                         ", frozen_events, "\n")
cat("At-risk person-days:            ", round(frozen_risk_days, 2), "\n")
cat("Incidence / 1000 person-days:   ", round(frozen_incidence, 4), "\n")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Overall Poisson goodness-of-fit / dispersion
#
# Dispersion ~1: participant event counts approximately Poisson.
# Dispersion >1: more heterogeneity/clustering than homogeneous Poisson.
#
# NOTE: this is a GLOBAL test and may reject because acquisition risk is
# genuinely heterogeneous between people/households. It is therefore not
# the most biologically specific test of recrudescence.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

pearson_chisq <- sum(
  residuals(poisson_fit, type = "pearson")^2
)

pearson_df <- df.residual(poisson_fit)

pearson_dispersion <- pearson_chisq / pearson_df

pearson_gof_p <- pchisq(
  pearson_chisq,
  df = pearson_df,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Observed versus Poisson-expected distribution of episode counts
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

lambda <- poisson_model_df$expected_events

event_distribution <- tibble(
  episodes = c("0", "1", "2", "3+"),

  observed = c(
    sum(poisson_model_df$n_events == 0),
    sum(poisson_model_df$n_events == 1),
    sum(poisson_model_df$n_events == 2),
    sum(poisson_model_df$n_events >= 3)
  ),

  poisson_expected = c(
    sum(dpois(0, lambda)),
    sum(dpois(1, lambda)),
    sum(dpois(2, lambda)),
    sum(ppois(2, lambda, lower.tail = FALSE))
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_minus_expected = observed - poisson_expected
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Targeted biological test 1:
#    Are there MORE PEOPLE WITH >=2 distinct incident episodes than expected?
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

observed_repeaters <- sum(poisson_model_df$n_events >= 2)

expected_repeaters <- sum(
  ppois(1, lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Targeted biological test 2:
#    Are there MORE RECURRENT EVENTS (events after the first) than expected?
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

observed_recurrent_events <- sum(
  pmax(poisson_model_df$n_events - 1L, 0L)
)

# E[(N-1)+] for N ~ Poisson(lambda)
expected_recurrent_events <- sum(
  lambda - (1 - exp(-lambda))
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Parametric simulation under the fitted Poisson acquisition process
#
# One-sided tests because the recrudescence hypothesis predicts EXCESS
# within-person recurrence, not fewer repeat episodes.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

sim_stats <- replicate(
  B,
  {
    y <- rpois(
      n = length(lambda),
      lambda = lambda
    )

    c(
      repeaters = sum(y >= 2),
      recurrent_events = sum(pmax(y - 1L, 0L))
    )
  }
)

p_excess_repeaters <- (
  1 + sum(sim_stats["repeaters", ] >= observed_repeaters)
) / (B + 1)

p_excess_recurrent_events <- (
  1 + sum(
    sim_stats["recurrent_events", ] >= observed_recurrent_events
  )
) / (B + 1)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Compact final output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

poisson_summary <- tibble(
  participants_total = nrow(poisson_df),
  participants_with_evaluable_risk_time = nrow(poisson_model_df),

  total_incident_episodes = sum(poisson_model_df$n_events),
  total_at_risk_person_days = sum(poisson_model_df$at_risk_days),

  incidence_per_1000_person_days = rate_per_1000_pd,
  incidence_95CI_low = rate_ci_per_1000_pd[1],
  incidence_95CI_high = rate_ci_per_1000_pd[2],

  pearson_dispersion = pearson_dispersion,
  poisson_global_gof_p = pearson_gof_p,

  observed_people_with_2plus_episodes = observed_repeaters,
  poisson_expected_people_with_2plus_episodes = expected_repeaters,
  p_excess_people_with_2plus_episodes = p_excess_repeaters,

  observed_recurrent_events_after_first = observed_recurrent_events,
  poisson_expected_recurrent_events_after_first = expected_recurrent_events,
  p_excess_recurrent_events_after_first = p_excess_recurrent_events
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("POISSON RECURRENT-EPISODE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

print(poisson_summary, width = Inf)

cat("\nObserved versus Poisson-expected episode-count distribution:\n\n")
print(event_distribution, n = Inf)

cat("\nPoisson regression:\n\n")
print(summary(poisson_fit))

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("INTERPRETATION\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

if (p_excess_repeaters >= 0.05 &&
    p_excess_recurrent_events >= 0.05) {

  cat(
    "There is NO evidence of an excess of recurrent episodes within\n",
    "participants relative to the fitted Poisson acquisition process.\n",
    "This is compatible with recurrent detections representing distinct\n",
    "acquisitions/reinfections rather than frequent recrudescence.\n",
    sep = ""
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "Recurrent episodes are more concentrated within participants than\n",
    "expected under the fitted Poisson acquisition process.\n",
    "This is compatible with recrudescence/intermittent shedding, but is\n",
    "not specific for it because heterogeneous exposure and household\n",
    "transmission can also generate excess clustering.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}


dir.create(here::here("outputs", "reproducibility"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(
  poisson_summary,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "poisson_recurrence_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  event_distribution,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "poisson_episode_count_distribution.csv")
)

```
